audit.limits: Host-managed provenance and final SQLite state, not signed external execution attestation. The recorded runtime control flow claims reservations before execution; SQLite has no per-transition timestamp history.

publication_policy.host_paths: No host absolute paths included; raw artifact keys are paths relative to the retained run root.
publication_policy.provider_identity: Only opaque declared policy hashes and generic scripted control labels are published.
publication_policy.trajectory_payloads: Public event summaries retain every event digest and metadata plus payload digest/keys; repository text/action bodies remain in the raw local trajectories.
publication_policy.stdout: Exact actual stdout SHA-256 and return codes retained for every hidden case; raw hidden stdout text was not persisted by this verifier.
publication_policy.canonical_digest_serialization: Producer/ledger canonical JSON uses sorted keys, compact separators, finite values and ensure_ascii=True. Realworld task/event hashes use ensure_ascii=False. File SHA-256 hashes exact retained bytes.

task_json.prompt: In the pinned Boltons repository, singularize() incorrectly removes the final s from already singular words ending in ss (for example, glass). Repair this without breaking existing plural forms such as glasses, and submit the workspace.

tool_manifest.name: run_visible_checks
tool_manifest.description: Run the fixed visible import check.

tool_manifest.name: submit
tool_manifest.description: Freeze and submit the repository workspace.

reward_contract.description: One point if every held-out command case matches its expected result.

limits: One known public Boltons repair fixture, scripted actors, one sequential control run; no unseen-task generalization result.
The original select_prompts function is imported normally and called once; the original trainer and optimizer are not run.
Provider costs measure fixed scripted calls, not inference latency or token cost.
Wall and component costs are actual observations, not paired acceleration measurements.
Episode wall cost includes reset/provider/actions/verifier/cleanup/final read-only guards, excluding admission/claim/persistence; budget charges one unit per dispatched episode.

Candidate timeout/output-limit handling inherits the binary failure contract only with confirmed owned-container cleanup; infrastructure/provider/unknown failures stay charged and unresolved without reward. No such failures occurred in this run.
The dependency byte pins cover this macOS ARM64 cohort, not every imported library or platform.
The declared policy hash binds controller/prompt/configuration, not attested remote model weights.
Trainer-ready token trajectories, model sampling, optimizer updates, GPU acceleration and multi-task allocation savings remain outside this result.
